translation: Now I have composed a chart, and appended its explanation after it, to reveal the secret treasury of a thousand ages. [When] examining the right hand, inside and outside are reversed from this. Qibo said: When the front region is as if external, it is the foot Greater Yang Bladder; when it moves it causes dizziness, and stiffness and pain of the head, neck, lower back, and spine; in men, damp and itchy genitals below; in women, lower abdominal pain drawing to the life gate (mingmen), pain within the genitals, closure of the uterus, and unfavorable menstruation. Floating is wind, rough (se) is cold, slippery (hua) is taxation-heat, tight (jin) is retained food.
